facts.text: {name} has played bridge with the Chief Executive every Thursday for eleven years.
facts.told: You'll have seen {name} leaving early on Thursdays, for bridge with the Chief Executive, every week for eleven years, so I'd watch what I said, that's all.

facts.text: The post of Team Leader was abolished in a reorganisation two years ago, and nobody has told {name}.
facts.told: They abolished the Team Leader post, you know, two years ago in the reorganisation, and nobody has told {name}, because I don't think anyone knows how.

facts.text: {name} wrote the company's values statement at a kitchen table, in one afternoon, for a bet.
facts.told: You know the values statement? {name} wrote that at a kitchen table, in one afternoon, for a bet, and integrity was the bit that won it.

facts.text: {name} is the only person alive who knows the password to the system that pays everyone.
facts.told: If {name} ever goes under a bus, none of us gets paid. {name} is the only one left with the password to the pay system.

facts.text: {name} was engaged for six years to the Head of Internal Audit, which ended badly, and the audit is still open.
facts.told: {name} was engaged to the Head of Internal Audit for six years, and it ended badly, and the audit's still open, so make of that what you like.

facts.text: {name} has kept a dated record of every promise made on this floor since 2014, and has made copies.
facts.told: {name} writes it all down, you know, every promise made on this floor since 2014, with dates, and there are copies.

facts.text: {name} reports privately to the Chief Financial Officer on what really happens at this level.
facts.told: I'd be careful around {name}, who has a private line to the Chief Financial Officer about what really goes on down here.

facts.text: {name} has been on the redundancy list for two years. The list has been lost, and nobody dares to ask for it.
facts.told: {name} has been on the redundancy list for two years. Then someone lost the list, and nobody dares ask for it back.

facts.text: {name} has a signed offer from the company's largest competitor, and is staying on to see how this ends.
facts.told: {name} has a signed offer from the competition sitting in a drawer, and is only staying to see how this ends.
